clips.title: The story
paras: At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora mourns Lady Sathrah's madness. Once cherished by Elune, the great spider has become dangerous, and the Sisterhood seeks to end her suffering and recover her sacred spinnerets.

In Darnassus's Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora grieves for Lady Sathrah. Sathrah was once blessed by Elune. Beneath the night sky, she wove delicate silver webs that caught the evening mist on Teldrassil's boughs. The Sisterhood of Elune gathered and kept the shimmering dew from those webs, which held healing powers for their sacred ministrations.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.
But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.
Find Lady Sathrah, friend, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.
It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The forest mourns for Lady Sathrah, but it was something that had to be done.
